authorizedBy: Mission utilisateur : clôture du corpus annuel, délégation des choix pédagogiques raisonnables et réversibles
scope: Annual local content only; no class adoption, no subject creation, no hours, no coefficients

criteria.domains: Five existing MINEDUB-referenced domains in each local stage; no official equivalence.
criteria.annualBreadth: Six distinct extensions per domain in addition to the original anchor: language, exploration and early mathematics, daily life, arts, movement.
criteria.adaptation: Four supported developmental stages; no fixed performance or age threshold.
criteria.assessment: Contextual observation and support recorded, revisiting and remediation; no diagnostic score.
criteria.scheduling: Flexible repeated workshops; no ministerial weekly calendar inferred.

writeEffect: Repository content only; baseline validation receipts untouched
